_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Uri Muhari {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe.
Chimiro chako ndicho kuhwina mitsara mitatu mfululizo (kwa mpimo, wima, kana diagonally) pa bodo.
Pasi yako, unofanira kusarudza nambari ye mraba (0-8) unoda kuisa chapa yako ndima.
Sekuru, '[4]' inaisa chapa yako mukati me seli ye bodo.
Seku Muhari {player_id}, uchava '{symbol}', wakati mukwasha wako ari '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} harisi sero rinoshanda. Rinofanira kuva pakati pe 0 ne 8.

game_action.placed: Muhari {player_id} akaisa chapa yake ({symbol}) mukati me seli {cell}.
